rejected.text: The Gate to the Afterlife is a massive stone barrier where the Luxa meets the Hekma, which opens at the Hours.
It was promised to open when the second sun sits between the horns, and at the Hours it opens to reveal endless wastes and the Necropolis rather than paradise.
Razaketh stood atop it, and the gate's opening unleashed horrors, with the scarab god standing before it.
The latest mention describes a sandstorm sweeping in from the direction of the gate.
